panels.title: Deployment complete cost components
panels.note: First three components sum to attributed_seconds for a representative run; cost_seconds is independent complete warmed median. Do not sum these totals together. Missing or blocked deployment remains NA.

panels.title: Policy coverage and false acceptance
panels.note: Decisions use calibration and deployable features only. Confirmation truth audits decisions afterward; finite empirical coverage is not a distribution-free guarantee.

panels.title: Reference uncertainty and unresolved evidence
panels.note: A tighter solver error beneath reference uncertainty is unresolved. Spatial and time refinement are not interchangeable.

panels.title: First invocation versus randomized warmed timing
panels.note: First observed invocation is not guaranteed process-cold startup. Speed comparisons use randomized warmed measurements; first-call savings do not establish amortization.

panels.title: Independent field intervals error_ratio
panels.note: Descriptive field-cluster bootstrap; repeated seeds and physics do not increase independent field count. Missing intervals remain absent, never zero width.

panels.title: Independent field intervals speed_ratio
panels.note: Descriptive field-cluster bootstrap; repeated seeds and physics do not increase independent field count. Missing intervals remain absent, never zero width.

panels.title: Five gate evidence and missing coverage
panels.note: Teal GOOD, coral BAD, gray NA. Scores are predeclared check-weight attainment, never scientific quality, effect size, or a proof.

panels.title: Independent function risk and available evidence
panels.note: Binomial upper bound is conditional on iid comparable fields and a frozen policy. No accepted functions means NA; repeated query rows are not independent trials.

panels.title: Supported amortization including offline costs
panels.note: Requires matched accuracy, accepted learned queries and positive saving uncertainty bound. All-classical routing or startup timing differences cannot earn neural amortization.

panels.title: Every native software test execution
panels.note: Repeated cases in different allocations remain separate executions. Skipped tests never count as passed GPU readiness; software correctness is not scientific superiority.
